method_note: Projections are computed in the browser at page load from the inputs in this file — standings, contenders' conference game logs, remaining conference games, and each conference's tiebreak steps encoded as data. For every remaining conference game involving a live contender, both outcomes are enumerated; berths are resolved under the encoded tiebreak steps. CLINCHED = berth in every combination; ELIMINATED = berth in none; CONTROLS_OWN_PATH = berth in every combination where the team wins its remaining games; NEEDS_HELP = every other live team. The projected pairing is the berth set when every remaining game is won by the team with the better current conference winning percentage (standings-hold). A tie surviving every encoded step is reported unresolved, never guessed — and a berth that depends on an unresolved tie counts as possible, not secured: CLINCHED and CONTROLS_OWN_PATH are asserted only where the berth is established by record or a fully resolved tiebreak in every relevant combination. Remaining games between two teams with no live contender are not enumerated; they cannot change a berth except through deep tiebreak steps, and are reflected on the next input refresh.
